SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.28
EXPLANATION: Two strong Raman bands lie at 2298 cm⁻¹ and 2235 cm⁻¹. A nitrile ν(C≡N) stretch normally appears near 2250 cm⁻¹ (rule GFQ-009) while an internal alkyne ν(C≡C) stretch is typically a little lower (rule GFQ-010). Only candidate 9 (CCC#CC(C)C#N) contains both a nitrile and an internal C≡C bond, matching the presence of two distinct ≡-bond stretches. The intense CH-stretch region at 2937–2990 cm⁻¹, plus medium-intensity CH₂/CH₃ deformation bands at 1461 and 1323 cm⁻¹, fit the aliphatic chain of candidate 9. No peaks characteristic of Si–H (≈2100–2200 cm⁻¹ plus 900–1000 cm⁻¹) or other heteroatoms appear that would favor the alternative structures. Thus candidate 9 best accounts for the experimental spectrum.
